sources.snippet: prior-coins: post-hoc SDF on instruct models Research checkpoints from the prior_coins study (science-of-midtraining). They test whether synthetic-document finetuning (SDF) applied on top of an already-instruct-tuned Gemma 3 model installs a prior that survives a shared, deliberately ambiguous alignment-finetuning (AFT) stage.
